|game_text=Deploy on table. When you fire two weapons (except lightsabers) in a battle, your total power is +5. Also, S-foils and Maneuvering Flaps are suspended where you have either a weapon present or a starship (or vehicle) with maneuver &gt; 3 present. (Immune to Alter.)

|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/crossfire.html</ref>

Tactical weapon work comes to [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]]! Fire any two weapons in a battle for power + 5. Useful if mixed with forfeit reducing weapons as that forces maybe 2 or 3 characters to be lost if your weapon destinies are good enough!

But the real kicker for this card is the suspension of a key aspect of the [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers{{!}}Hidden Base]] Swarm deck - S-Foils. All you need is a weapon present or maneuver > 3. For the Dark Side against souped up X-Wings that means all the difference! [[TIE Defender Mark I]], Slave 1, [[TIE Avenger]], [[Black 2]]...

If you are facing a [[Snowspeeder]] and [[Maneuvering Flaps]] deck, that's even easier! A [[Speeder Bike (Dark){{!}}Speeder Bike]] will do it! Is it a 'flappy' clouds deck? Your [[Combat Cloud Car]] is the one for the job then!

Combo:

Just when the X-Wing swarm thought it had you. Drats! "Foiled" again!
|rulings=* If a weapon firing is canceled, that weapon did not fire and does not count towards [[Crossfire]].<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Crossfire</ref>
